## Raw dump (verbatim)

I want to make a video about why systems beat hustle. Everyone in my world thinks the answer to being slammed is to wake up earlier and grind harder. That is the trap. I worked 80 hour weeks for two years and my business did not grow, It stayed the same while making me a worse overall person. What actually changed was that I built a system for client onboarding. I realized that I was doing the same thing over and over again, and I needed to start to build systems. I want to show people that the goal is not to do more, the goal is to build the thing that does it for you.

The onboarding system is the one I always point to. I had a client, Marcus, who cut his onboarding from 5 hours per client down to 1 hour just by writing the steps down and handing them off.

I like the restaurant kitchen comparison. A good kitchen runs because every station knows its job, not because the chef is faster than everyone else.

The payoff for the viewer is they pick one repeatable task this week and write the steps down so someone else can run it.
